title: Table (source-canonical)
description: A data / reference table from an ESGE Position Statement — clinical decision tables, side-by-side comparisons, scoring rubrics, etc. Distinct from `cat` (which is an assessment instrument with score-per-item semantics) and from `qi` (which is a single indicator with target thresholds). Stored as structured rows so the reader can display it as a proper HTML table.

cell.description: Multilingual table cell. Unlike narrative strings, a cell may be intentionally empty where the source uses row/column spans.

number.description: Table N (as printed) — may include letter suffix (e.g. '2a', '2b').

rows.description: Table body rows. Each row's `cells` length should match `columns` length.

isGroupHeader.description: True when this row is a spanning sub-heading (e.g. 'Adverse events' before a group of QIs). Renderer emits a full-width `<th>` row instead of `<td>`s.

rowSpans.description: Source rowspan for each physical cell, preserving the publisher table layout.

colSpans.description: Source colspan for each physical cell, preserving the publisher table layout.

footnotes.description: Optional footnote markers → text (e.g. superscript 1 → citation).

assessesRecommendations.description: Optional back-references to recommendation lineageIds that this table supports.

$comment: Tables live at esge/table/<curriculum-slug>/table-<N>.v1.0.0.json. Copyright: table content is CC BY 4.0 verbatim from source (allowed under the paper's licence).
